note: Paths are illustrative; keep the routes the site uses today. One template, audience prop picks the content source.

url.q: ?q=<question> puts the page in the answered state on load and after Ask; removed on Clear and browse
url.history: Ask pushes one entry (home -> answered). A follow-up replaces that entry. Clear and browse pops it. Back from answered returns to home with the pill emptied.
url.audience: from the route, never a query param

search_pill.placeholder: Ask anything, e.g. How do I connect my brokerage?
search_pill.typeahead: none in this iteration; the pill is a question box, not a filter

states.typing: same as empty; Ask AI enables at 3+ characters
states.asking: emerald border and 3px halo, Ask AI shows a 14px spinner and reads Asking; field stays editable
states.answered: emerald border and halo, solid emerald Ask AI; 'Clear and browse' link appears under the pill

try_chips.click: fills the pill and submits immediately

ask_flow.request: existing Ask AI endpoint with {question, audience}
ask_flow.expects: { answer: string, steps?: string[], sources: [{id,title,category,url,readMinutes}], matches: [{articleId,category,score}] }

derive.matchesByCategory: count of distinct matched articles per category; drives the rail highlights and the Keep reading counts
derive.relatedArticles: matches sorted by score desc, sources first; first gets BEST MATCH; show 6, 'See all N results' expands in place
derive.keepReading: top 3 categories by match count; per category up to 3 matched articles that are not already sources; header count is the full match count for that category
derive.stillTrending: first 3 of the audience's trending list, excluding anything already in sources or related

ask_flow.in_place: the home body unmounts and the answered body mounts; the header stays; scroll position resets to the top of the answer card
ask_flow.streaming: if the endpoint streams, the answer text fills in with a caret; sources, rail counts, Keep reading and Related render when the final payload arrives, as skeletons until then
ask_flow.no_sources: render the no-answer state; never show answer text without at least one source

resting.row: icon tile, name, chevron; whole row is a link to the category page

matches.row_with_matches: background --hc-tint, count in --hc-positive mono 600 on the right; row links to the category page filtered by ?q=
matches.row_without: opacity .5, middle dot on the right, still a link
matches.note: one line under the list, 11px faint
matches.sorting: keep the canonical category order; do not resort by count

category_rail.a11y: a nav landmark labelled Categories; counts are read as 'N matching articles' via visually hidden text

answer_card.label: AI ANSWER with the spark mark; right side 'from N help articles'
answer_card.steps: render the numbered list only when the payload includes steps; never derive steps from the prose
answer_card.sources: chips in payload order; each opens the article; max 5 visible, '+N more' expands
answer_card.footer: caveat left, 'Was this helpful?' plus thumbs right

feedback.click: thumb fills; the pair disables; a 'Thanks' text replaces the question
feedback.down: also reveals a one-line optional text field 'What was missing?' with Send

follow_up.field: pill, placeholder 'e.g. Which brokerages support SnapTrade?'
follow_up.submit: Enter or Ask; the question moves into the main pill, the new answer replaces the card in place, history entry replaced
follow_up.context: send the previous question and answer ids as context to the endpoint if it supports it; otherwise send the follow-up alone

keep_reading.per_card: icon, category name, match count, up to 3 article links, 'All {category} articles'
keep_reading.fewer_categories: render what exists; with one category the card spans the middle column at full width
keep_reading.empty: hide the section entirely when no matches remain after removing sources

related_articles.row: icon tile, title (wraps to 2 lines max), category, read time, BEST MATCH tag on the first
related_articles.see_all: expands in place to all matches; label becomes 'Show fewer'

home_blocks.start_here: three cards = the three most-opened categories for the audience (from analytics or a configured list); card is a link
home_blocks.faq: four questions in two columns; clicking one submits it to Ask AI (it is a question, not an article)
home_blocks.recently_updated: five most recently updated articles for the audience; 'All updates' opens the changelog view of the help centre
home_blocks.trending: six most-viewed articles in the last 7 days for the audience; 'All popular articles' opens the list
home_blocks.help_card: Contact Support opens the contact form for the audience; Back to Help Center is a link

states.loading_home: skeletons for the three Start here cards, five updated rows, six trending rows, twelve rail rows; nav and header render immediately
states.asking: answer card skeleton (label, 5 text lines, 3 chip pills), Keep reading and Related skeletons, rail rows keep their names with count placeholders
states.no_answer: answer card replaced by a quiet card: 'We could not find an answer in the help centre. Try different words, browse a category, or contact support.' with Browse categories and Contact Support; rail stays in resting mode; Related shows keyword matches if any, else hidden
states.error: same card shape: 'The assistant is unavailable right now. Browse a category or try again in a moment.' with Try again; the home body stays visible underneath in dimmed form only if the swap has not happened yet
states.empty_audience_list: a block with no items (e.g. no trending yet) is hidden, never an empty heading
states.reduced_motion: no shimmer travel, no caret blink, no card transitions

keyboard.tab_order_home: nav, crumb, pill, Ask AI, Try chips, rail rows, Start here cards, FAQ rows, updated rows, All updates, help card buttons, trending rows, All popular
keyboard.tab_order_answered: nav, crumb, pill, Ask AI, Clear and browse, rail rows, source chips, thumbs, follow-up field, Ask, Keep reading links, Related rows, See all, Still trending rows, help card buttons
keyboard.escape: in the pill: clears the text; in the follow-up: clears the text
keyboard.focus_after_ask: moves to the answer card heading (AI ANSWER) with tabindex=-1
